About CodeGen4Future

CodeGen4Future is a competitive programming and collaboration platform built for students, developers, and teams who want to learn, practice, and compete in a modern, real-time environment.

Our Mission

To make coding practice, interview preparation, and contests accessible to everyone by providing a fast, intuitive, and feature-rich online playground.

What You Can Do

  • Solve coding problems with an in-browser editor
  • Compete in live contests and challenges
  • Play 1 vs 1 duels with friends
  • Participate in team battles and tournaments
  • Track your progress via ratings and leaderboards

For Students & Placements

The platform is designed keeping campus placements and coding interviews in mind. Sharpen your DSA skills, compete with peers, and build confidence before facing real tests.

For Teams & Communities

Host internal contests, organize friendly battles, and create a healthy competitive coding culture in your college or community.

Ready to start?
